crossRefs.note: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of…
He set the gatekeepers at the gates of Yahweh’s house, that no one who was unclean in anything should enter in.
They performed the duty of their God, and the duty of the purification, and so did the singers and the gatekeepers…
“ ‘ “But the Levites who went far from me, when Israel went astray, who went astray from me after their idols, they…
Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and ministering in the house.…
Yet I will make them performers of the duty of the house, for all its service, and for all that will be done therein.

translations.web: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of Yahweh’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.
translations.bsb: So they and their descendants were assigned to guard the gates of the house of the LORD—the house called the Tent.
translations.kjv: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the LORD, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.
translations.asv: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of Jehovah, even the house of the tent, by wards.
